notes.title: Ceplion
notes.notes:
Join me while I playthrough the demo and answer your questions! 

[b]Embark on an epic journey in Ceplion, a metroidvania-inspired action-platformer. Explore the Ceplion Island, uncovering mysteries and ancient secrets. Engage in precise combat against believers and monstrous creatures. Harness the power of inheritors to bring an end to the relentless war.[/b]

Whitney is a rebellious girl who lives in a small town in [i]Kearnia[/i]. After losing her parents to war, she starts fighting for survival in the cold, dark streets. As the war escalates, she has to flee the town. So she escapes by boarding a freighter as a fugitive. When she finally arrives at [i]Ceplion[/i] Island, she begins to wander around. But little did she know, she was about to uncover a miracle that would change the fate of the entire mankind.
